info.longBusinessSummary: PCL Technologies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, researches, manufactures, and sells optical transceiver products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers optical transceivers, fiber channels, TO-Can packages, and optical sub-assemblies, as well as sub-assembly and module products. It also offers tooling design services. In addition, the company provides reliability and testing support services comprising of design, pilot run, mass production, quality control and process improvement services. Further, it engages in research, manufacture, and sale of optical components; international trade; and provision of related skills and post-sales services. PCL Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.
